research_question: What imbalance, confounding, and leakage are induced by speaker, emotion, source, and raw-processed pair structure?
hypothesis: File-level evaluation is optimistic because of speaker or paired-view overlap.
secondary_evidence: Manifest; source-emotion and speaker-emotion tables; pair-quality statistics; Sankey; heatmaps
decision_focus: Quantify the problem and determine whether C1 is supported

research_question: How do five deep-learning architectures compare under one pair-safe speaker-disjoint protocol and common front-end?
hypothesis: Complex models may improve recognition while OrionNet-LM offers a better efficiency trade-off.
secondary_evidence: Accuracy; parameters; training time; inference latency; pre/post-tuning
decision_focus: Select a defensible federated backbone and answer the course model-comparison requirement

research_question: How does OrionNet-LM change from original-like file-level evaluation to speaker-disjoint pair-safe evaluation?
hypothesis: The clean protocol lowers scores but better estimates unseen-speaker generalization.
secondary_evidence: Leakage count; confidence interval; per-class differences
decision_focus: Measure protocol bias; never use leakage-prone performance as the main result

research_question: How do Centralized, Local-only, FedAvg, FedProx, and FedBN differ under speaker-non-IID VESC?
hypothesis: At least one of FedProx or FedBN improves client stability over FedAvg.
primary_metrics: Raw Macro-F1; raw UAR; mean-client Macro-F1
secondary_evidence: Accuracy; per-class recall; client SD; confusion matrix; convergence
decision_focus: Establish the federated baseline without assuming a winner

research_question: Does Label-Aware PVC improve raw recognition and raw-processed stability over supervised FL, adding processed data, and fixed PVC?
hypothesis: Label-Aware PVC improves raw performance and stability without materially harming singleton utterances.
primary_metrics: Raw Macro-F1; raw UAR; pair agreement; mean JS divergence
secondary_evidence: Processed metrics; paired/singleton results; correctness quadrants
decision_focus: Separate gains from extra data and gains from the proposed weighting mechanism

research_question: How does PVC-FedOrion respond to client heterogeneity and pair availability, and what does it cost?
hypothesis: PVC benefits clients with adequate pairs; update size is unchanged but local computation increases.
primary_metrics: Global and mean-client Macro-F1; client SD; performance by pair ratio
secondary_evidence: Local time; rounds to target; cumulative transmitted bytes
decision_focus: Measure robustness and the performance-cost trade-off
